notes.title: 《Brawl'Destructive》the Sumggler DLC
notes.notes:
Even the abandons consider Smuggler dangerous and try to avoid them.
These folks are the scariest and most dangerous being among Avengers.
Smuggler cover their face with white skull mask.
In the dark , armed with bows and swords , they quietly wait for the prey to come .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662983/fdb895f4d54f67bba7b5f0ff0a4926df7952307b.png[/img]
-Hiding 
disappears without a trace

-Stab
cause very high damage to a target with dagger while hiding 
 
-Lure
deploy a dummy to lure enemy ,and the dummy will explode

Brawl'Destructive will update at 2020 10 27.
update content:

1 new hero :Lion Hearts

Not like the name , Lion Hearts doesn't look like courage folks.
However , their value and spirits shine in the battlefield.
Even in the most miserable situations , they never give up and eventually earn a victory.
This is why they called Lion Hearts.

notes.title: "Brawl 'Destructive " officially launched, welcome to experience
notes.notes:
The multiplayer online game "Brawl 'Destructive" has been officially launched. All players can experience the game for free. have a good time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38662983/6e9b6361b136b23af48a8d9bc0cb602f21e90899.jpg[/img]

"Destruction effect" is a game that combines diablo style ARPG and MoBa. The game provides a variety of heroes with different performances for players to experience. The heroes are divided into two camps: Guardians and Abandons. The two camps can cooperate with each other or fight  each other. Players can choose according to their own preferences.



Players can work together to challenge all kinds of Dungeons. All kinds of equipment will be dropped from the Dungeons. Constantly challenge the Dungeons and create a divine costume for their heroes!



If you want to pursue stimulation further, you can also participate in multi player combat and experience the feeling of wandering on the edge of death.



New heroes, Dungeons, equipment, mounts and pets will be constantly updated to ensure that the players will have a continuous sense of freshness. By follow our trends, you can know the update status of the game at the first time.



Start the adventure of Planet Titan!



(the game is currently in the state of no file deletion test. The game will be officially launched on October 1. Various welfare activities will be launched at that time. )
